goal: Remove webcam/camera continuity completely, add startup GitHub update check and auto-download with platform-specific asset delivery, and set monochrome notification icon

steps.title: Remove phone camera webcam and camera continuity completely from desktop and Android apps
steps.note: Removed phone camera webcam and camera continuity completely across Android (deleted WebcamService, GlSurfacePipe, CameraEncoder, ContinuityCameraActivity, UI routes, tests) and Desktop (removed QML cards/tiles, settings section, shortcuts, tray items, capabilities). All core tests passed (113 maclink-core, 62 maclink-protocol). Git commit f46499e.

steps.title: Add GitHub auto-update check on every app start with platform-specific asset download
steps.note: Added GitHub update check on every app start and automatic background staging/download. Platform-specific delivery implemented across macOS (.dmg/.pkg/.zip), Windows (-x64/-arm64/.exe), Linux (.AppImage/.deb/.tar.gz), and Android (.apk with ABI preference). All core and protocol unit tests pass. Git commit 441b13b.
